title: Nine Sweets of Paper
subtitle: 糖果与甜食 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 糖果与甜食（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：糖果与甜食（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：candy　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 candy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my mother was sent to share ① candy she could not refuse, and she said the refusing was the whole of the lesson. The ② candy, meaning the sweets and not the sugar, was nine pieces and was handed round by whoever came last; candy, she said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ candy in that jar had the same wrapper, and the ④ candy at the front, meaning the one the shopman kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly. Candy, my grandmother said, is nine parts sugar and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the sugar is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ candy was the whole of the birthday, meaning the party it sweetened and not the sweets. The ⑥ candy, meaning the party and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody shares and nobody questions; candy, he said, is either something you refuse or the only word that means both sweets and a party. She said the party is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ candy had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the wrapper. The ⑧ candy of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pieces and eleven years of sharing; candy, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ candy I remember is the one at the front, which was handed round in 1972 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ piece of candy, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being shared; every candy, she said, is a party that has agreed to look like sweets. She said the party was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 糖果（指那些糖块本身，与糖相对）
C. 固定搭配：share candy 分糖果
D. n. 糖果（指罐子里每一块）
E. n. 糖果（指前面那一块）
F. n. 糖果（抽象：它添了甜的那场聚会）
G. n. 那场聚会（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The candy, meaning the sweets and not the sugar
candy was the whole of the birthday
the candy had become a photograph in a report
The candy of the whole thing
A piece of candy, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: share candy 意为“分糖果”，1951 年母亲被派去分那些她推不掉的糖果。
candy 意为“糖果”，指那些糖块本身而不是糖，共九块，由最后走的人分出去。
candy 指罐子里每一块糖，每一块都是同样的糖纸。
candy 指前面那一块（店主留的那一块），是唯一有人认真数过的。
candy 意为“糖果”，抽象指它添了甜的那场聚会，父亲说 candy 就是那个生日聚会的全部。
candy 为抽象用法，指那场聚会本身，是屋子里人人都分、却没人质疑的东西。
candy 意为“糖果、甜食”，到 1967 年这些 candy 成了报告里的一张照片。
candy 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九块糖和十一年的分食。
candy 意为“糖果”，我记得的是前面那一块，1972 年被分着吃，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
candy 为抽象总称，祖母说一块糖是唯一会因为被分着吃而变好的东西。

The candy at the front, meaning the one the shopman kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly.
